story.title: Canadian Prime Minister Carney Discusses Trade Progress with Trump Ahead of U.S. Midterms
story.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney reported having a productive conversation with U.S. President Donald Trump regarding the future of Canada-U.S. trade. Carney indicated that their discussion built on previous talks about a potential trade deal aimed at creating jobs, lowering costs for families, and protecting Canada's cultural and linguistic sovereignty.

related_stories.title: Haley Stevens Endorses Mike Rogers Following Withdrawal from El-Sayed Event
related_stories.summary: Haley Stevens has publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers for the Michigan Senate seat after being disinvited from an event by Abdul El-Sayed's campaign due to a dispute over an antisemitic advertisement. This endorsement marks a significant shift in the race, potentially impacting El-Sayed's campaign as polls tighten in the final days before the election.

related_stories.title: Federal Judge Dismisses Trump's Lawsuit to Block Alaska Senate Race Certification
related_stories.summary: A federal judge has dismissed a lawsuit from the Trump administration that sought to block the certification of results from Alaska's U.S. Senate race, contingent on the Republican incumbent losing. The state government of Alaska had argued against the lawsuit, calling the demands 'impossible.'

related_stories.title: Alaska Attorneys Reject Trump's Request to Set Aside Senate Ballots as 'Meritless'
related_stories.summary: Attorneys for Alaska have described Trump's demand to set aside Senate ballots as 'meritless' and 'not even possible.' This statement comes amid a broader investigation by the Department of Justice, which has issued subpoenas related to the case. Additionally, there is a request for a judge to separate ballots showing votes for a specific candidate until it can be determined if voters were misled into voting for a spoiler candidate.

related_stories.title: Ciara Mageean, European Champion Runner, Dies at 34 After Cancer Battle
related_stories.summary: Ciara Mageean, the Irish Olympian and European 1,500m champion, has passed away at the age of 34 after a battle with cancer. Mageean, who represented Ireland in two Olympic Games, revealed her cancer diagnosis a year prior to her death. Tributes have been paid from various figures, including President Catherine Connolly.
